scope: Frozen before measuring any Tecnick image with any codec. This file records a protocol, not results.
corpus: TESTIMAGES (Asuni and Giachetti) SAMPLING 8BIT RGB 2400x2400 C00C00, 40 published images
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; used for research measurement only, images are not redistributed

cohorts.tecnick-crop512: Sorted file-name positions 1,4,...,34 (12 images), one centered 512x512 crop each, exact samples
cohorts.tecnick-2400: Sorted file-name positions 0,3,...,33 (12 images), native 2400x2400 publisher PNG bytes unchanged

selection: Fixed by fetch_tecnick.py from sorted names only, before any compression measurement. The other 16 images stay unused. No result-based exclusions.
prior_known_inputs: All 24 Kodak images; all 14 SIPI miscellaneous color images; SIPI aerials 2.1.01-2.1.12, 2.2.01, and wash-ir. Settings were tuned only on those. No Tecnick image was opened by any codec before this protocol.
native_backend: nnproto_integer.cpp built -O3 -std=c++17 for arm64; x86_64 build under Rosetta for the alternate-ISA check

learned.schedule_note: 5% linear warmup, cosine decay to a 1% floor
learned.training_note: Grouped trains the three planes in one batched step with independent weights, optimizer state, and per-plane gradient clipping at 10.
learned.training_tiles: Above the limit, evenly spread 256x256 tiles with 6-pixel causal margins; every pixel is still coded
learned.precision_search: Encode in that order and stop after the first candidate larger than its predecessor
learned.format: self-contained integer NNEX v3 with entropy-coded exact binary16 weights and SHA-256 raw RGB checksum

prior_round_reference.note: The previous frozen aerial settings, retrained here without the SCDX floor. Written as NNEX v3, so this delta excludes the separately measured v2-to-v3 model-coding saving. The previous round could not train above 1,048,576 pixels, so for tecnick-2400 its result would have been the SCDX floor.

selection_rule: Encode the floor and every learned candidate, verify each independently, choose the smallest complete file. Keep the floor on ties.
baselines: Exact RGB PNG (Pillow optimize), WebP lossless cwebp 1.6.0 -lossless -z 9 -exact, JPEG XL lossless effort 9 and effort 10 via imagecodecs libjxl 0.12.0 with one thread; verify every round-trip
reporting: All 24 images, per cohort and combined: per-image and aggregate complete-file bytes including transmitted models and headers, median per-image saving against the smallest baseline, win count, exact RGBA verification, hashes, encode and decode seconds. Alternate-ISA decode and byte-identical re-encode of every selected NNEX file. No tuning during or after these cohorts; any rerun is a regression, not fresh validation.
execution: Up to three concurrent workers on one Mac; runtimes are not isolated latency.
limitations: One publisher's studio photographs; crops are not native full frames. Not a comparison against every codec (for example closed context-mixing image compressors). Production defaults remain unchanged.
